hub.v1.BeaconParamsV1.description: BeaconParamsV1 controls retained beacon history and VRF activation policy.

max_vrf_key_history_epochs.description:
max_vrf_key_history_epochs is genesis/upgrade-only and must cover the
beacon audit and replay window. The activation delay is the fixed V1
constant 1 and is deliberately not a parameter.

hub.v1.BeaconState.description:
BeaconState records one height's randomness output.

Dev chains may still write placeholder_blockhash_v1 entries for local
testing. Mainnet business randomness must use proposer_vrf_v1 entries that
carry the proof/proposer audit fields and verified=true.
BeaconState defines the BeaconState wire type.

block_hash.description: block_hash is the committed header hash at this exact height.

proof_digest.description:
proof_digest is SHA256(raw proof bytes) for proposer_vrf_v1 entries. The
raw proof exists only while the proposal is verified and is never stored
or exported. It is absent/omitted for dev-only placeholder entries;
present-empty and all-zero values are invalid.

proposer_consensus_address.description:
proposer_consensus_address is the consensus proposer identity checked by
ProcessProposal / PreBlocker before this state is persisted.

randomness_hex.description:
randomness_hex is the canonical lower-case hex encoding of the 32-byte
beacon value R_h.

source_tag.description:
source_tag identifies how the value was derived:
placeholder_blockhash_v1 or proposer_vrf_v1.

verified.description:
verified is true only after the proposal validation path has verified
proof_h against the operator's active VrfKeyState public key.

hub.v1.BridgeBootstrapModeV1.description:
BridgeBootstrapModeV1 is the irreversible first-inbound fee-bootstrap state.

 - BRIDGE_BOOTSTRAP_MODE_V1_UNSPECIFIED: Unset; rejected.
BRIDGE_BOOTSTRAP_MODE_V1_UNSPECIFIED identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - BRIDGE_BOOTSTRAP_MODE_V1_DISABLED: No bootstrap is armed; every optional bootstrap field must be absent.
BRIDGE_BOOTSTRAP_MODE_V1_DISABLED identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - BRIDGE_BOOTSTRAP_MODE_V1_ARMED: One first inbound transfer may bypass the fee; all binding fields must be present.
BRIDGE_BOOTSTRAP_MODE_V1_ARMED identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - BRIDGE_BOOTSTRAP_MODE_V1_CONSUMED: The single bootstrap transfer has been used. Terminal and irreversible.
BRIDGE_BOOTSTRAP_MODE_V1_CONSUMED identifies the corresponding protocol value.

hub.v1.BridgeLifecycleV1.description:
BridgeLifecycleV1 is the canonical USDC bridge lifecycle.

 - BRIDGE_LIFECYCLE_V1_UNSPECIFIED: Unset; rejected on any read or write path.
BRIDGE_LIFECYCLE_V1_UNSPECIFIED identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - BRIDGE_LIFECYCLE_V1_ACTIVE: Normal operation: the confirmed local and EVM ISM agree.
BRIDGE_LIFECYCLE_V1_ACTIVE identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - BRIDGE_LIFECYCLE_V1_PENDING_EVM_CONFIRMATION: A cutover has begun and the bridge stays frozen until the EVM side is confirmed.
BRIDGE_LIFECYCLE_V1_PENDING_EVM_CONFIRMATION identifies the corresponding protocol value.

hub.v1.BridgeParamsV1.description: BridgeParamsV1 bounds the canonical USDC guard and governance lifecycle.

hub.v1.BridgeStatusViewV1.description: BridgeStatusViewV1 joins TrueOpen state, upstream Hyperlane state, and bank supply.

hub.v1.BuilderParamsV1.description: BuilderParamsV1 groups governed fixed-set and duty parameters.

hub.v1.BuilderSetViewV1.description: BuilderSetViewV1 projects the public BuilderSet header and bounded body.

hub.v1.BuilderState.description:
BuilderState is the stable Builder identity and current service binding.
Phase 0 registration creates only this identity and its descriptor; it does
not create admission, bond, score, term, or set membership.
BuilderState defines the BuilderState wire type.

current_service_pubkey.description: REST input accepts the standard or URL-safe Base64 alphabet, padded or unpadded; REST output is always the canonical padded standard-alphabet form.

hub.v1.CandidatePoolMemberViewV1.description:
CandidatePoolMemberViewV1 is the Query-only verifiable join of one member row
and its immutable binding (§16.5). The snapshot scope comes from the request.
CandidatePoolMemberViewV1 defines the CandidatePoolMemberViewV1 wire type.

hub.v1.CandidatePoolParamsV1.description: CandidatePoolParamsV1 groups global candidate pool parameters (§18.0).

hub.v1.CandidatePoolSnapshotStatus.description:
CandidatePoolSnapshotStatus is the snapshot lifecycle. Numeric values are
frozen (sole closed-enum authority).
CandidatePoolSnapshotStatus defines the CandidatePoolSnapshotStatus wire type.

 - CANDIDATE_POOL_SNAPSHOT_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED: Never written; rejects zero-value rows.
CANDIDATE_POOL_SNAPSHOT_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - CANDIDATE_POOL_SNAPSHOT_STATUS_READY: Published header, not yet effective_height.
CANDIDATE_POOL_SNAPSHOT_STATUS_READY identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - CANDIDATE_POOL_SNAPSHOT_STATUS_ACTIVE: Current pool; the only snapshot a first Worker proposal may lock.
CANDIDATE_POOL_SNAPSHOT_STATUS_ACTIVE identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - CANDIDATE_POOL_SNAPSHOT_STATUS_EXPIRED: Past expires_height; still usable by tasks that already locked it.
CANDIDATE_POOL_SNAPSHOT_STATUS_EXPIRED identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - CANDIDATE_POOL_SNAPSHOT_STATUS_PRUNED: Body deleted; only the retained header answers by-ID queries.
CANDIDATE_POOL_SNAPSHOT_STATUS_PRUNED identifies the corresponding protocol value.

hub.v1.CandidatePoolSnapshotViewV1.description:
CandidatePoolSnapshotViewV1 is the Query-only snapshot projection frozen by
api_contract §16.5. It hides source_revision and refcounts and never lands in the
Store. status = PRUNED does not mean an empty pool.
CandidatePoolSnapshotViewV1 defines the CandidatePoolSnapshotViewV1 wire type.

hub.v1.CortexNodeState.description:
CortexNodeState is the single stable Cortex identity row (§6.4). Fields 10-12
are the three online-responsibility counters that the API contract /
§10.0c1 require MsgRotateServiceKey to see at zero; they replace the previous
string-keyed TASK_LIABILITY_* responsibility rows.
CortexNodeState defines the CortexNodeState wire type.

current_service_pubkey.description:
33-byte compressed secp256k1 service key, not a digest; REST uses Base64.

REST input accepts the standard or URL-safe Base64 alphabet, padded or unpadded; REST output is always the canonical padded standard-alphabet form.

hub.v1.CurrentServiceKeyViewV1.description: CurrentServiceKeyViewV1 is the current key binding projection of §16.5.

service_pubkey.description:
33-byte compressed secp256k1 service key, not a digest; REST uses Base64.

REST input accepts the standard or URL-safe Base64 alphabet, padded or unpadded; REST output is always the canonical padded standard-alphabet form.

hub.v1.DailySupportState.description: DailySupportState is one operator/epoch support heartbeat row (data-structure contract 6.1).

signature_digest.description:
SHA256(raw_signature_64), retained as a 32-byte audit/exact-replay fingerprint.
The 64-byte signature was verified before initial live acceptance and is not retained.
This digest is not authorization state and never enters a signing/business digest;
replay compares it only to identify the same previously accepted signature.

hub.v1.EarningsState.description: EarningsState is the direct-finality pull-payment ledger.

hub.v1.EmergencyFreezeVote.description:
EmergencyFreezeVote is one validator's ballot on a freeze signal. Values are
frozen.
EmergencyFreezeVote defines the EmergencyFreezeVote wire type.

 - EMERGENCY_FREEZE_VOTE_UNSPECIFIED: Never accepted; rejects an unset ballot.
EMERGENCY_FREEZE_VOTE_UNSPECIFIED identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - EMERGENCY_FREEZE_VOTE_ACCEPT: Vote to emergency-freeze the profile.
EMERGENCY_FREEZE_VOTE_ACCEPT identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - EMERGENCY_FREEZE_VOTE_REJECT: Vote against emergency-freezing the profile.
EMERGENCY_FREEZE_VOTE_REJECT identifies the corresponding protocol value.

hub.v1.EmergencyFreezeVoteState.description:
EmergencyFreezeVoteState is one validator ballot
(the data-structure contract, key
(freeze_signal_id, validator_consensus_address)).

validator_consensus_address is ConsensusAddressBytes resolved by the Keeper
from the Tx signer through the staking keeper; it is never a caller field and
never an account address. voting_power_snapshot is read from the frozen
validator snapshot. No signature digest is stored, because the Cosmos Tx
signer already authorizes the ballot and §10.0a removed the same-account
detached signature.
EmergencyFreezeVoteState defines the EmergencyFreezeVoteState wire type.

validator_consensus_address.description:
CometBFT consensus address bytes (20 bytes), not a Hash32; REST uses Base64.

REST input accepts the standard or URL-safe Base64 alphabet, padded or unpadded; REST output is always the canonical padded standard-alphabet form.

hub.v1.EpochParamsV1.description: EpochParamsV1 groups epoch length and boundary parameters (§18.0).

hub.v1.FaultKind.description:
FaultKind is the closed objective fault kind of one role fault receipt (9.6b).

 - FAULT_KIND_UNSPECIFIED: Never written; rejects zero-value receipts.
FAULT_KIND_UNSPECIFIED identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - FAULT_KIND_TIMEOUT: Assigned duty missed its deadline.
FAULT_KIND_TIMEOUT identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - FAULT_KIND_INVALID_RESULT: Submitted material was objectively invalid.
FAULT_KIND_INVALID_RESULT identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - FAULT_KIND_EQUIVOCATION: Two conflicting accepted submissions for one scope.
FAULT_KIND_EQUIVOCATION identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - FAULT_KIND_BUILDER_OBJECTIVE_FAULT: Builder objective evidence was accepted against the operator.
FAULT_KIND_BUILDER_OBJECTIVE_FAULT identifies the corresponding protocol value.

hub.v1.FreezeFailureClassCountsV1.description:
FreezeFailureClassCountsV1 is the per-class breakdown of the failures a freeze
signal aggregated.

CONTRACT-GAP: the data-structure contract writes
`included_failure_class_counts = METRIC_THRESHOLD_BREACH / OBJECTIVE_FAULT /
SCHEMA_FAULT / WORKER_EVIDENCE_FAULT` without giving a wire shape. The four
listed classes are exactly the freeze-eligible TaskFailureClass values, so
they are encoded as four fixed counters instead of an unbounded repeated
list; INSUFFICIENT_VERIFIER is deliberately absent because §6.1 and §10.12
keep it out of the freeze root and count it separately as
excluded_insufficient_verifier_count.
FreezeFailureClassCountsV1 defines the FreezeFailureClassCountsV1 wire type.

hub.v1.FreezeParamsV1.description: FreezeParamsV1 groups emergency freeze window and quorum parameters (§18.0).

hub.v1.FreezeSignalState.description:
FreezeSignalState is the profile-level risk object validators vote on.

The Keeper builds it from the single next fully closed fixed risk window and
only from TaskFailureClassState rows with freeze_signal_eligible=true; the
caller never submits the window, the failure set, counters or hashes.
included_failure_task_refs_hash is the TRUEOPEN_FREEZE_FAILURE_REFS_V1 rolling
root, so the refs array itself is never stored. validator_snapshot_height,
validator_set_hash and total_voting_power_snapshot freeze at OPEN time so the
validator set cannot drift during voting.
FreezeSignalState defines the FreezeSignalState wire type.

hub.v1.FreezeSignalStatus.description:
FreezeSignalStatus is the freeze signal lifecycle. Values are frozen by
the API contract.
FreezeSignalStatus defines the FreezeSignalStatus wire type.

 - FREEZE_SIGNAL_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED: Never written; rejects zero-value signal rows.
FREEZE_SIGNAL_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - FREEZE_SIGNAL_STATUS_BUILDING: Only the build cursor exists; no vote object yet.
FREEZE_SIGNAL_STATUS_BUILDING identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - FREEZE_SIGNAL_STATUS_OPEN: Voting is open until vote_deadline_height.
FREEZE_SIGNAL_STATUS_OPEN identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - FREEZE_SIGNAL_STATUS_ACCEPTED: ACCEPT voting power reached two thirds and the profile was frozen.
FREEZE_SIGNAL_STATUS_ACCEPTED identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - FREEZE_SIGNAL_STATUS_REJECTED: REJECT voting power made two thirds ACCEPT unreachable.
FREEZE_SIGNAL_STATUS_REJECTED identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - FREEZE_SIGNAL_STATUS_EXPIRED: The deadline runner closed a still-OPEN signal.
FREEZE_SIGNAL_STATUS_EXPIRED identifies the corresponding protocol value.

hub.v1.HubParamsMetaState.description:
HubParamsMetaState is the authoritative Hub params version pointer. It is a
singleton written atomically with HubParamsV2 so MsgUpdateHubParams can reject
a stale expected_version and so QueryParams can return the frozen
params_hash without recomputing it.

params_hash is the §18.0 digest
H_FIELDS_V1("TRUEOPEN_HUB_PARAMS_V2", chain_id, new_version, canonical HubParamsV2).

CONTRACT-GAP: the data-structure contract registers no State row for the params
version/hash even though the API contract code 110 both
require a persisted current version and hash. The shape below is the minimal
row that satisfies those two requirements and nothing more.
HubParamsMetaState defines the HubParamsMetaState wire type.

hub.v1.HubParamsV2.description: HubParamsV2 is the single Hub parameter root.

hub.v1.ModelProfileStatus.description:
ModelProfileStatus is the shared model and profile lifecycle status; numbers are frozen by the upstream model registry projection referenced from 9.6b.

 - MODEL_PROFILE_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED: Never written; rejects zero-value rows.
MODEL_PROFILE_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - MODEL_PROFILE_STATUS_REGISTERED: Registered but not yet usable for new tasks.
MODEL_PROFILE_STATUS_REGISTERED identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - MODEL_PROFILE_STATUS_ACTIVE: Usable for new tasks.
MODEL_PROFILE_STATUS_ACTIVE identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - MODEL_PROFILE_STATUS_FROZEN: Governance frozen; unfreezing returns to REGISTERED.
MODEL_PROFILE_STATUS_FROZEN identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - MODEL_PROFILE_STATUS_EMERGENCY_FROZEN: Frozen by the validator emergency freeze quorum.
MODEL_PROFILE_STATUS_EMERGENCY_FROZEN identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - MODEL_PROFILE_STATUS_DELISTED: Terminal; never returns to a usable status.
MODEL_PROFILE_STATUS_DELISTED identifies the corresponding protocol value.

hub.v1.ModelState.description: ModelState is one registered model primary row (data-structure contract 6.3).

hub.v1.ModelStatusSource.description:
ModelStatusSource attributes one model status transition to its trigger.

 - MODEL_STATUS_SOURCE_UNSPECIFIED: Never written.
MODEL_STATUS_SOURCE_UNSPECIFIED identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - MODEL_STATUS_SOURCE_AUTO_PROFILE: Derived from the aggregate profile status.
MODEL_STATUS_SOURCE_AUTO_PROFILE identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - MODEL_STATUS_SOURCE_GOVERNANCE: Applied by a governance transition.
MODEL_STATUS_SOURCE_GOVERNANCE identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - MODEL_STATUS_SOURCE_EMERGENCY: Applied by the emergency freeze path.
MODEL_STATUS_SOURCE_EMERGENCY identifies the corresponding protocol value.

hub.v1.ModelSupportActivationKind.description:
ModelSupportActivationKind records which task fact first activated one support row (6.1).

 - MODEL_SUPPORT_ACTIVATION_KIND_UNSPECIFIED: Never written.
MODEL_SUPPORT_ACTIVATION_KIND_UNSPECIFIED identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - MODEL_SUPPORT_ACTIVATION_KIND_NONE: Support row has not been activated by any task fact.
MODEL_SUPPORT_ACTIVATION_KIND_NONE identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - MODEL_SUPPORT_ACTIVATION_KIND_WORKER_P30_ORDER_VALUE: Activated by a worker task at or above the P30 order value cutoff.
MODEL_SUPPORT_ACTIVATION_KIND_WORKER_P30_ORDER_VALUE identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - MODEL_SUPPORT_ACTIVATION_KIND_VERIFIER_ASSIGNED_VALID: Activated by an assigned verifier duty on a valid task.
MODEL_SUPPORT_ACTIVATION_KIND_VERIFIER_ASSIGNED_VALID identifies the corresponding protocol value.

hub.v1.ModelSupportState.description: ModelSupportState is the single roleless operator/profile support row (6.1); it carries no duty selector.

hub.v1.ParameterBucketParamsV1.description: ParameterBucketParamsV1 groups versioned bucket caps and retention (§18.0).

hub.v1.ParameterBucketVersionViewV1.description:
ParameterBucketVersionViewV1 projects the public content of one timeout
bucket version. It hides task_ref_count and store
keys, and bucket_hash is the same value ParameterBucketVersionState stores as
content_hash.
ParameterBucketVersionViewV1 defines the ParameterBucketVersionViewV1 wire type.

hub.v1.Phase0ParamsV1.description: Phase0ParamsV1 freezes the tokenless-mainnet denomination and fee profile.

evm_chain_id.description: Numeric EIP-712 chain ID. It is independent from the Cosmos chain-id.

hub.v1.PriceParamsV1.description:
PriceParamsV1 fixes the Phase 0 Profile Ref step and arithmetic boundaries.
All fields are genesis-only.
PriceParamsV1 defines the PriceParamsV1 wire type.

hub.v1.ProfileCapabilityState.description: ProfileCapabilityState is one operator/profile declared capability row (6.1).

hub.v1.ProfileState.description: ProfileState is one registered model profile primary row plus its roleless support aggregate (6.3).

hub.v1.ProfileStatusSource.description:
ProfileStatusSource attributes one profile status transition to its trigger.

 - PROFILE_STATUS_SOURCE_UNSPECIFIED: Never written.
PROFILE_STATUS_SOURCE_UNSPECIFIED identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - PROFILE_STATUS_SOURCE_AUTO_SUPPORT: Derived from the roleless support aggregate.
PROFILE_STATUS_SOURCE_AUTO_SUPPORT identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - PROFILE_STATUS_SOURCE_GOVERNANCE: Applied by a governance transition.
PROFILE_STATUS_SOURCE_GOVERNANCE identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - PROFILE_STATUS_SOURCE_EMERGENCY: Applied by the emergency freeze path.
PROFILE_STATUS_SOURCE_EMERGENCY identifies the corresponding protocol value.

hub.v1.QueryBeaconResponse.description: QueryBeaconResponse is response type for Query/Beacon.

hub.v1.QueryBridgeStatusResponse.description: QueryBridgeStatusResponse returns a same-height bridge invariant join.

hub.v1.QueryBuilderResponse.description: QueryBuilderResponse returns the Builder primary row.

hub.v1.QueryBuilderSetResponse.description: QueryBuilderSetResponse is response type for Query/BuilderSet.

hub.v1.QueryBuildersResponse.description:
QueryBuildersResponse walks the builder primary map in canonical store key
byte order. That is the Bech32 string key order, which is not guaranteed to
match raw address byte order; the contract fixes the key order so no handler
has to collect the whole table to re-sort it.
QueryBuildersResponse defines the QueryBuildersResponse wire type.

hub.v1.QueryCandidatePoolMemberResponse.description:
QueryCandidatePoolMemberResponse returns the verifiable member/binding join.
A pruned body is FailedPrecondition; only an unknown snapshot or member is
NotFound.

CONTRACT-GAP: api_contract §3.6 describes this response as "member +
membership_binding" while §16.3 registers exactly `1=member` and §16.5 freezes
CandidatePoolMemberViewV1 at four fields with no membership_binding. The
§16.3/§16.5 shape is implemented.
QueryCandidatePoolMemberResponse defines the QueryCandidatePoolMemberResponse wire type.

hub.v1.QueryCandidatePoolMembersResponse.description:
QueryCandidatePoolMembersResponse walks slots in ascending order under the
count and bytes caps; a pruned snapshot body is FailedPrecondition for the whole
call.
QueryCandidatePoolMembersResponse defines the QueryCandidatePoolMembersResponse wire type.

hub.v1.QueryCandidatePoolSnapshotRespons.description:
QueryCandidatePoolSnapshotResponse projects the public header and hides build
and refcount fields. status = PRUNED does not mean an empty pool; member
queries must then return FailedPrecondition.
QueryCandidatePoolSnapshotResponse defines the QueryCandidatePoolSnapshotResponse wire type.

hub.v1.QueryCompetitionEpochResponse.description: QueryCompetitionEpochResponse returns the authoritative competition aggregate.

hub.v1.QueryCortexNodeResponse.description: QueryCortexNodeResponse returns the Cortex primary row.

hub.v1.QueryCurrentCandidatePoolResponse.description:
QueryCurrentCandidatePoolResponse returns the one ACTIVE snapshot the current
pointer resolves to; a missing pointer is NotFound and the Query never triggers
a build.
QueryCurrentCandidatePoolResponse defines the QueryCurrentCandidatePoolResponse wire type.

hub.v1.QueryCurrentServiceKeyResponse.description: QueryCurrentServiceKeyResponse returns the authoritative binding lifecycle.

hub.v1.QueryDailySupportResponse.description: QueryDailySupportResponse returns the retained heartbeat row.

hub.v1.QueryEarningsResponse.description: QueryEarningsResponse is response type for Query/Earnings.

hub.v1.QueryEmergencyFreezeVotesResponse.description:
QueryEmergencyFreezeVotesResponse pages the primary map prefix directly in
ascending validator consensus address bytes order; no same-key KeySet exists.
QueryEmergencyFreezeVotesResponse defines the QueryEmergencyFreezeVotesResponse wire type.

hub.v1.QueryEventParamsV1.description: QueryEventParamsV1 groups Query pagination and event payload caps (§18.0).

hub.v1.QueryFaultResponse.description: QueryFaultResponse returns the authoritative role fault row.

hub.v1.QueryFreezeSignalResponse.description:
QueryFreezeSignalResponse returns the retained signal header; after the
summary retention it is NotFound.
QueryFreezeSignalResponse defines the QueryFreezeSignalResponse wire type.

hub.v1.QueryFreezeSignalsResponse.description:
QueryFreezeSignalsResponse walks only the profile index in ascending
(risk_window_end_height, freeze_signal_id) order.
QueryFreezeSignalsResponse defines the QueryFreezeSignalsResponse wire type.

hub.v1.QueryHubParamsResponse.description: QueryHubParamsResponse is response type for the Query/Params RPC method.

meta.description:
meta carries this module's own params version/hash/updated height. Params
ownership stays per module: a client that needs a joint view calls
hub.v1.Query/Params and task.v1.Query/Params at the same

params.description: params holds all the parameters of this module.

hub.v1.QueryModelResponse.description: QueryModelResponse is response type for Query/Model.

hub.v1.QueryModelSupportResponse.description: QueryModelSupportResponse returns one node-level P30 support row.

hub.v1.QueryModelsResponse.description:
QueryModelsResponse walks the model primary map in canonical store key byte
order. An empty registry is an empty list, not NotFound.
QueryModelsResponse defines the QueryModelsResponse wire type.

hub.v1.QueryProfileResponse.description: QueryProfileResponse is response type for Query/Profile.

hub.v1.QueryRewardEpochAuditResponse.description:
QueryRewardEpochAuditResponse returns the immutable root left after bounded
reward-body pruning.
QueryRewardEpochAuditResponse defines the QueryRewardEpochAuditResponse wire type.

hub.v1.QueryRewardEpochCursorResponse.description:
QueryRewardEpochCursorResponse exposes only phase and the visited/applied
counts.
QueryRewardEpochCursorResponse defines the QueryRewardEpochCursorResponse wire type.

hub.v1.QueryServiceBondResponse.description: QueryServiceBondResponse returns the bond with recomputed invariants.

hub.v1.QueryServiceDescriptorResponse.description: QueryServiceDescriptorResponse returns the bounded descriptor row.

hub.v1.QueryTreasuryResponse.description:
QueryTreasuryResponse returns the treasury row; a mismatch between the module
account balance and the logical sub-ledgers is Internal.
QueryTreasuryResponse defines the QueryTreasuryResponse wire type.

hub.v1.QueryValidatorBridgeSignerRespons.description: QueryValidatorBridgeSignerResponse returns the registered bridge signer.

hub.v1.QueryVrfKeyResponse.description: QueryVrfKeyResponse returns the active key and optional next-epoch key.

active_vrf_pubkey.description: REST input accepts the standard or URL-safe Base64 alphabet, padded or unpadded; REST output is always the canonical padded standard-alphabet form.

pending_vrf_pubkey.description: REST input accepts the standard or URL-safe Base64 alphabet, padded or unpadded; REST output is always the canonical padded standard-alphabet form.

hub.v1.RewardBucket.description:
RewardBucket is the independent order-value competition bucket.

 - REWARD_BUCKET_UNSPECIFIED: Unset; rejected.
REWARD_BUCKET_UNSPECIFIED identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - REWARD_BUCKET_P0: Order value bucket 0, the lowest band.
REWARD_BUCKET_P0 identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - REWARD_BUCKET_P1: Order value bucket 1.
REWARD_BUCKET_P1 identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - REWARD_BUCKET_P2: Order value bucket 2.
REWARD_BUCKET_P2 identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - REWARD_BUCKET_P3: Order value bucket 3.
REWARD_BUCKET_P3 identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - REWARD_BUCKET_P4: Order value bucket 4, the highest band.
REWARD_BUCKET_P4 identifies the corresponding protocol value.

hub.v1.RewardCompetitionBootstrapStatus.description:
RewardCompetitionBootstrapStatus selects bootstrap or measured P30 cutoff.

 - REWARD_COMPETITION_BOOTSTRAP_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED: Unset; rejected.
REWARD_COMPETITION_BOOTSTRAP_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - REWARD_COMPETITION_BOOTSTRAP_STATUS_BOOTSTRAP: Too few samples for a real cutoff, so the configured bootstrap floor applies.
REWARD_COMPETITION_BOOTSTRAP_STATUS_BOOTSTRAP identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - REWARD_COMPETITION_BOOTSTRAP_STATUS_ACTIVE: The epoch met the minimum sample count and uses its own derived cutoff.
REWARD_COMPETITION_BOOTSTRAP_STATUS_ACTIVE identifies the corresponding protocol value.

hub.v1.RewardCompetitionEpochState.description: RewardCompetitionEpochState is the Phase 0 P30/support aggregate.

hub.v1.RewardEpochAuditState.description:
RewardEpochAuditState is the immutable result of bounded retention pruning.
Phase 0 requires eligible_task_count, mark_count, and accrual_count to be zero.
RewardEpochAuditState defines the RewardEpochAuditState wire type.

hub.v1.RewardEpochPhase.description:
RewardEpochPhase is the public bounded-runner phase registry. Phase 0 only
persists HISTOGRAM_OPEN and CUTOFF_DERIVED; COMPLETE is response-only.
RewardEpochPhase defines the RewardEpochPhase wire type.

 - REWARD_EPOCH_PHASE_UNSPECIFIED: Unset; rejected.
REWARD_EPOCH_PHASE_UNSPECIFIED identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - REWARD_EPOCH_PHASE_HISTOGRAM_OPEN: The epoch is still accumulating its order value histogram.
REWARD_EPOCH_PHASE_HISTOGRAM_OPEN identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - REWARD_EPOCH_PHASE_CUTOFF_DERIVED: The P30 cutoff has been derived from the closed histogram.
REWARD_EPOCH_PHASE_CUTOFF_DERIVED identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - REWARD_EPOCH_PHASE_ELIGIBILITY_RUNNING: The bounded eligibility scan is in progress.
REWARD_EPOCH_PHASE_ELIGIBILITY_RUNNING identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - REWARD_EPOCH_PHASE_RANDOMNESS_WAIT: Waiting for the future beacon height the epoch draw is bound to.
REWARD_EPOCH_PHASE_RANDOMNESS_WAIT identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - REWARD_EPOCH_PHASE_MARK_RUNNING: Reserved for the mark runner. Phase 0 never enters it: RewardMark and MarkGate stay switched off.
REWARD_EPOCH_PHASE_MARK_RUNNING identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - REWARD_EPOCH_PHASE_COMPLETE: The epoch is closed and its audit root is frozen. Terminal.
REWARD_EPOCH_PHASE_COMPLETE identifies the corresponding protocol value.

hub.v1.RewardEpochProgressViewV1.description:
RewardEpochProgressViewV1 is the public projection of RewardEpochCursorState.
The internal cursor keys
last_order_value_bucket / last_task_id are deliberately not exposed, and the
cursor is deleted on completion, so a finished epoch returns NotFound instead
of a fabricated total or root.
RewardEpochProgressViewV1 defines the RewardEpochProgressViewV1 wire type.

hub.v1.RewardParamsV1.description: RewardParamsV1 groups reward competition and accrual parameters (§18.0).

hub.v1.RoleFaultState.description:
RoleFault is a single recorded fault attributed to one task duty.

fault_id is deterministic and deduplicates the same observation across
re-runs. WORKER and VERIFIER describe the duty assigned by the protocol for
this task; they are not node-declared roles.
RoleFaultState defines the RoleFaultState wire type.

hub.v1.RoleFaultStatus.description:
RoleFaultStatus is the lifecycle of one recorded role fault receipt (6.4).

 - ROLE_FAULT_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED: Never written; rejects zero-value rows.
ROLE_FAULT_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - ROLE_FAULT_STATUS_CONFIRMED: Fault receipt is the current attribution.
ROLE_FAULT_STATUS_CONFIRMED identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - ROLE_FAULT_STATUS_SUPERSEDED: Replaced by a later attribution.

hub.v1.ServiceBondState.description: ServiceBondState is the single operator-global service bond row, including the operator-global jail counters (data-structure contract 6.4).

hub.v1.ServiceBondStatus.description:
ServiceBondStatus is the operator-global service bond lifecycle (data-structure contract 6.4).

SERVICE_BOND_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - SERVICE_BOND_STATUS_REGISTERED: Bond row created but not yet effective.

hub.v1.ServiceDescriptorState.description:

hub.v1.ServiceEndpointV1.description: ServiceEndpointV1 is one bounded descriptor endpoint (9.6b).

hub.v1.SupportParamsV1.description: SupportParamsV1 groups model support and heartbeat parameters (§18.0).

hub.v1.TreasuryParamsV1.description: TreasuryParamsV1 groups treasury split and retention parameters (§18.0).

shared.v1.BatchVerification.description: BatchVerification defines bounded multi-sample aggregation when enabled.

shared.v1.BucketKind.description:

shared.v1.Duty.description:

shared.v1.EpochTaskSummary.description:
EpochTaskSummary is the bounded U1 summary emitted by Task at epoch close.

shared.v1.EvidenceKind.description:
EvidenceKind is the single cross-module numeric authority for evidence

 - EVIDENCE_KIND_SETTLEMENT_ROOT_OPENING: Settlement duty Builder opening against task_evidence_root.
EVIDENCE_KIND_SETTLEMENT_ROOT_OPENING identifies the corresponding protocol value.

shared.v1.EvidenceSchemaV1.description:
EvidenceSchemaV1 is the readable descriptor committed by

EvidenceSchemaV1 defines the EvidenceSchemaV1 wire type.

shared.v1.FailureClassificationSource.description:
FailureClassificationSource attributes one task failure classification to its trigger. 9.6b is the sole numeric authority for these four values.

FAILURE_CLASSIFICATION_SOURCE_UNSPECIFIED identifies the corresponding protocol value.

shared.v1.GenerationType.description:
GenerationType defines whether output generation uses deterministic or sampled decoding.

InferEvidenceRequirementV1 defines the InferEvidenceRequirementV1 wire type.

NumericScale defines the fixed-point encoding used by verification metrics.

ParticipantType selects the Hub identity domain a service key or descriptor belongs to (9.6b).

 - PARTICIPANT_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Never written; rejects zero-value rows and selectors.

shared.v1.PricingProfile.description: PricingProfile freezes the immutable inputs to Phase 0 output-token pricing.

shared.v1.QueryPageRequestV1.description:
QueryPageRequestV1 is the only pagination request wire (§16.1). V1 allows
keyset pagination only: there is no offset and no count_total. limit = 0 uses
max_query_page_limit; a non-zero value above that cap is InvalidArgument and
must not be silently clamped. page_token is the optional canonical PageTokenV1
encoding bounded by max_query_page_token_bytes.
QueryPageRequestV1 defines the QueryPageRequestV1 wire type.

limit.description: limit is 0 for max_query_page_limit, otherwise <= that cap.

page_token.description:
page_token is empty on the first page and otherwise a canonical PageTokenV1.
It is an opaque variable-length cursor blob, not a Hash32, so REST projects it
as ProtoJSON Base64.

REST input accepts the standard or URL-safe Base64 alphabet, padded or unpadded; REST output is always the canonical padded standard-alphabet form.

shared.v1.QueryPageResponseV1.description:
QueryPageResponseV1 returns the next keyset token; it is empty when no next
item exists (§16.1). A non-empty token is only returned when the server has
actually seen a next item.
QueryPageResponseV1 defines the QueryPageResponseV1 wire type.

next_page_token.description:
next_page_token is empty when the walk is complete. Same opaque PageTokenV1
blob as page_token, so REST projects it as ProtoJSON Base64.

REST input accepts the standard or URL-safe Base64 alphabet, padded or unpadded; REST output is always the canonical padded standard-alphabet form.

shared.v1.RoundOutcomeV1.description:
RoundOutcomeV1 is the terminal outcome of the optional Phase 0 verification
round. The initial round has no RoundOutcomeV1; its verdict is carried by the
Task-owned VerificationRoundState.
RoundOutcomeV1 defines the RoundOutcomeV1 wire type.

 - ROUND_OUTCOME_V1_UNSPECIFIED: No round-2 outcome exists.
ROUND_OUTCOME_V1_UNSPECIFIED identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - ROUND_OUTCOME_V1_CONCURRED: Round 2 reached the same explicit verdict as round 1.
ROUND_OUTCOME_V1_CONCURRED identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - ROUND_OUTCOME_V1_DIVERGED: Round 2 reached the opposite explicit verdict from round 1.
ROUND_OUTCOME_V1_DIVERGED identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - ROUND_OUTCOME_V1_UNRESOLVED: Enough material arrived, but no complete verdict/count key reached threshold.
ROUND_OUTCOME_V1_UNRESOLVED identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - ROUND_OUTCOME_V1_UNAVAILABLE: The round could not form a legal verifier set or reached data-unavailable threshold.
ROUND_OUTCOME_V1_UNAVAILABLE identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - ROUND_OUTCOME_V1_EXPIRED: The round-close deadline expired before another terminal branch completed.
ROUND_OUTCOME_V1_EXPIRED identifies the corresponding protocol value.

shared.v1.StoredBodyStatus.description:
StoredBodyStatus tells whether the bounded member body of a committed
collection row is still resident or has been pruned while its count and hash
stay auditable. The API contract registers the two values (and §9.6b
lists §16.5 as the numeric authority for them).

CONTRACT-GAP: §16.5 calls this a Query-only projection enum that never lands in
Store, yet the data-structure contract gives both BuilderSetState and
TaskBuilderSelectionState a stored `body_status = ACTIVE / PRUNED` field with
exactly these two values. Declaring a second Store-only enum would break the
§9.6b rule of one numeric definition per closed enum, so the single definition
lives here and is shared by the Store rows and the §16.5 views. It is declared
in shared/v1 because both x/hub and x/task store and project it,
and the module-split closure rule makes a declaration referenced by two domains
shared. The contract must either drop the "Query-only" wording or register a
Store twin.
StoredBodyStatus defines the StoredBodyStatus wire type.

 - STORED_BODY_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED: Never written; rejects zero-value rows and views.
STORED_BODY_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - STORED_BODY_STATUS_ACTIVE: Bounded member body is resident.
STORED_BODY_STATUS_ACTIVE identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - STORED_BODY_STATUS_PRUNED: Member body deleted; count and hash retained.
STORED_BODY_STATUS_PRUNED identifies the corresponding protocol value.

shared.v1.TaskFinalityStatusV1.description:
TaskFinalityStatusV1 is the single-settlement finality state shared by Task

state atomically.
TaskFinalityStatusV1 defines the TaskFinalityStatusV1 wire type.

 - TASK_FINALITY_STATUS_V1_UNSPECIFIED: Never persisted.

TASK_FINALITY_STATUS_V1_PENDING identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - TASK_FINALITY_STATUS_V1_FINAL: The unique settlement and all funds committed.
TASK_FINALITY_STATUS_V1_FINAL identifies the corresponding protocol value.

shared.v1.TaskType.description:
TaskType identifies a task family accepted by a profile.

 - TASK_TYPE_TEXT_GENERATION: TASK_TYPE_TEXT_GENERATION accepts text completion tasks.
 - TASK_TYPE_CHAT: TASK_TYPE_CHAT accepts structured conversational tasks.
 - TASK_TYPE_EMBEDDING: Values 3..6 are reserved for future profile generations. Phase 0 profile
admission accepts only TEXT_GENERATION and CHAT; enabling any value below
requires a new Wire release and matching execution/verification contract.
TASK_TYPE_EMBEDDING accepts embedding tasks.
 - TASK_TYPE_CLASSIFICATION: TASK_TYPE_CLASSIFICATION accepts classification tasks.
 - TASK_TYPE_IMAGE_GENERATION: TASK_TYPE_IMAGE_GENERATION accepts image generation tasks.
 - TASK_TYPE_MULTIMODAL: TASK_TYPE_MULTIMODAL accepts multimodal tasks.

shared.v1.TimeoutBootstrapProfile.description: TimeoutBootstrapProfile supplies bounded timeout values during profile bootstrap.

VerificationMode selects the profile verification aggregation mode.

 - VERIFICATION_MODE_SINGLE_SAMPLE: VERIFICATION_MODE_SINGLE_SAMPLE verifies one bound sample.
 - VERIFICATION_MODE_BATCH_SAMPLES: VERIFICATION_MODE_BATCH_SAMPLES verifies an aggregate of samples.

shared.v1.VerificationThresholds.description: VerificationThresholds freezes pass and reject boundaries for all metrics.

task.v1.ActiveTaskRefV1.description: ActiveTaskRefV1 is the compact active-duty Task reference of §16.5.

 - ASSIGNMENT_FAILURE_REASON_RANDOMNESS_UNAVAILABLE: Required future beacon never became available.

AssignmentStatus is the Worker assignment sub-state. Values are frozen by

 - ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_NONE: No assignment activity yet.

 - ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_WORKER_ASSIGNED: Winner finalized and liability reserved.

 - ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_ASSIGN_TIMEOUT: Assignment could not be completed.
ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_ASSIGN_TIMEOUT identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_WORKER_TIMEOUT: Winner missed the inference deadline.
ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_WORKER_TIMEOUT identifies the corresponding protocol value.

task.v1.BatchParamsV1.description: BatchParamsV1 bounds verification batch item counts and canonical bytes.

task.v1.BuilderDataUnavailableAggregateS.description:
aggregate_hash = H_FIELDS_V1("TRUEOPEN_DATA_UNAVAILABLE_AGGREGATE_V1",
    chain_id, task_id, verify_round, builder_operator_address,
    valid_report_count, required_report_count,
    uint32_be(selected_verifier_count), repeated(optional report_digest))

required_report_count is ceil(2 * the round's stored
selected_verifier_count / 3). status and threshold_reached_height are not
part of the hash. Only a confirmed round-1 row for an actual data-ready
attester may later produce tag 5; self-rescue and challenge-round rows remain
round failure/audit facts and never produce a Builder fault.
BuilderDataUnavailableAggregateState defines the BuilderDataUnavailableAggregateState wire type.

report_digests_by_verifier_slot.description:
One slot per selected verifier, in selected Verifier slot order, always
exactly selected_verifier_count of them. Slot i belongs to
VerifierAssignmentState.selected_verifiers[i] and carries its digest only if
that verifier filed a valid report.

task.v1.BuilderDataUnavailableAggregateS.title:
BuilderDataUnavailableAggregateState is the per
(task_id, verify_round, builder_operator_address) aggregate built at commit
deadline close. The slot vector length always equals the round's
VerifierAssignmentState.selected_verifier_count: for round 1 that is the
frozen selected_verifier_count parameter, while a challenge round freezes
challenge_verifier_count into the same state field. Slot i belongs to
VerifierAssignmentState.selected_verifiers[i]; a slot with no report_digest
means that verifier filed no valid report, encoded as presence byte 0x00 in
the preimage:

task.v1.BuilderDataUnavailableAggregateS.description:
BuilderDataUnavailableAggregateStatusV1 is the lifecycle of one
(task, round, builder) data-unavailable aggregate.

CONTRACT-GAP: the data-structure contract names the three states
(COLLECTING / CONFIRMED / PRUNED) but the API contract does not
register this enum, so the numbers below follow the declaration order of that
section and must be re-confirmed when §9.6b is extended.
BuilderDataUnavailableAggregateStatusV1 defines the BuilderDataUnavailableAggregateStatusV1 wire type.

 - BUILDER_DATA_UNAVAILABLE_AGGREGATE_STATUS_V1_UNSPECIFIED: Never written; rejects zero-value rows.
BUILDER_DATA_UNAVAILABLE_AGGREGATE_STATUS_V1_UNSPECIFIED identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - BUILDER_DATA_UNAVAILABLE_AGGREGATE_STATUS_V1_COLLECTING: Reports are still being collected; threshold not reached.
BUILDER_DATA_UNAVAILABLE_AGGREGATE_STATUS_V1_COLLECTING identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - BUILDER_DATA_UNAVAILABLE_AGGREGATE_STATUS_V1_CONFIRMED: Threshold reached at threshold_reached_height; aggregate_hash written once.
BUILDER_DATA_UNAVAILABLE_AGGREGATE_STATUS_V1_CONFIRMED identifies the corresponding protocol value.
 - BUILDER_DATA_UNAVAILABLE_AGGREGATE_STATUS_V1_PRUNED: Digest vector deleted by task cleanup; counts and aggregate_hash retained.
BUILDER_DATA_UNAVAILABLE_AGGREGATE_STATUS_V1_PRUNED identifies the corresponding protocol value.

task.v1.BuilderDataUnavailableSlotV1.description:
BuilderDataUnavailableSlotV1 is one selected-verifier slot of the
data-unavailable aggregate. It exists so a slot that filed no valid report can
say so with field presence instead of with a zero-length Hash32.

The two contracts used to disagree about how to spell an empty slot:
the data-structure contract fixed the vector length to
selected_verifier_count and let an empty element mean "this verifier has not
reported", while the API contract reject a zero-length
element inside a repeated Hash32. It is resolved in favour of

now says what the preimage always said.

task.v1.QueryTaskBuildersResponse.description:

commitment order (§16.2). It is the read path that makes the per-Task Builder

Pruning and compaction semantics, exactly as frozen by §16.2 and
the data-structure contract:
  - body_status = ACTIVE: selected_task_builders has exactly
    selected_task_builder_count == builders_per_task members in frozen order.
  - body_status = PRUNED: the cleanup runner's ACTIVE_INDEXES_AND_LIABILITIES
    phase (§6.6 step 7), after finality and the evidence-retention window,
    released every BUS_OBJECTIVE_EVIDENCE responsibility and cleared the member
    body. selected_task_builders MUST be empty while count/hash and the other
    public header fields remain auditable. The RPC is NOT NotFound in this
    window, and an empty member array with body_status = ACTIVE is Internal.
  - After the TASK_COMPACTION phase (§6.6 step 8) the whole
    TaskBuilderSelectionState row is deleted together with the rest of the Task
    detail, so the RPC returns NotFound and the long-lived commitment must be
    read from TaskTerminalSummaryState.selected_task_builders_hash instead. The
    PRUNED body therefore only exists between step 7 and step 8; a compacted
    Task must never be answered with a fabricated header.
  - An unknown task_id is NotFound; a non-canonical task_id is InvalidArgument;
    a header whose retained selected_task_builders_hash does not recompute from
    a still-resident body is Internal.
QueryTaskBuildersResponse defines the QueryTaskBuildersResponse wire type.

TaskBuilderSelectionViewV1 projects one TaskBuilderSelectionState and hides the
internal builder_set_ref_released and builder_fault_slash_bps_snapshot fields

the data-structure contract State field order.

This view is the ONLY read path for the per-Task Builder identity. The Worker
fetches INPUT from and uploads OUTPUT to exactly these Builders, the
three-Builder fan-out and the 2-of-3 data-ready confirmation address exactly
this list, and the API contract derives the stable SETTLE duty Builder
from the same frozen order and rank. No other surface carries it: the abandoned
AssignmentState.builder_operator_address is deleted, TaskCoreState and
TaskAssignmentState hold no Builder field, and EventWorkerAssignmentFinalized
(event code 11, §5.11) does not emit one.

BITMAP ORDER: the index of a Builder inside selected_task_builders IS the bit
index of both frozen Builder bitmaps, so a consumer must align them against
this list and never against its own sort:
  - MsgReportDataUnavailable.unavailable_task_builder_bitmap and
    DataUnavailableReportState.unavailable_task_builder_bitmap (§10.5)
  - TaskStageHandraiseUnionState.data_ready_attesting_builder_bitmap (§10.4)
Bit i addresses selected_task_builders[i]; byte_index = i / 8 and
bit_mask = 1 << (i % 8).

CONTRACT-GAP: §10.4 and §10.5 state only that the two Builder bitmaps use "the
frozen TaskBuilderSelectionState order" and that trailing/out-of-range bits are
rejected; neither restates the byte/bit layout, and §3.1 registers a bit order
(`bit_mask = 1 << (bit_in_segment % 8)`, little-bit order in each byte) only for
the segmented CandidatePool bitmap. The unsegmented Builder bitmap therefore
reuses that same §3.1 little-bit order, because §3.1 is the only bitmap codec
registered anywhere in the contract and a second bit order would silently fork
TRUEOPEN_DATA_UNAVAILABLE_BITMAP_V1 across languages. The contract must either
widen §3.1 to all bitmaps or restate the layout in §10.4/§10.5.
TaskBuilderSelectionViewV1 defines the TaskBuilderSelectionViewV1 wire type.

task.v1.TaskFailureClass.description:

time byte for byte, and the two beacon heights must be strictly increasing.

below window_size; ranking uses verifier_window_rank ascending with slot
ascending as tie-break.

task.v1.VerifierCandidateWindowState.description:
h0 = receipt_height
  h_window          = h0 + delta_w_blocks
  h_builder_close   = h_window + open_verify_builder_proposal_window_blocks
  h_handraise_close = h_builder_close + self_rescue_margin_blocks
  h_selection       = h_handraise_close + delta_w_blocks
  h_assignment_due  = h0 + verify_open_deadline_blocks
  require h0 < h_window < h_builder_close < h_handraise_close
          < h_selection < h_assignment_due
